```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(car)
```


```{r}
data <- read.csv("Environmental_Health_Data.csv")
```


```{r}
summary(data)
```


```{r}
cor_matrix <- cor(data[,-1])
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.8)
```


```{r}
model <- lm(ChronicIllnessRate ~ AirQualityIndex + WaterContamination + MedianIncome + EducationLevel, data = data)
summary(model)
```



```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model)
```



```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = AirQualityIndex, y = ChronicIllnessRate)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Chronic Illness vs Air Quality Index", x = "Air Quality Index", y = "Chronic Illness Rate")
```
